big: A client calls on the 12th: 'Why is the market down today?' An RM who knows the calendar can say, 'CPI inflation was just released. Let me explain.' The calendar turns news into a plan.

lines: AMFI monthly data around the 10th. CPI inflation around the 12th. RBI's MPC meets six times a year, the next in early December. GDP comes quarterly, about two months after quarter-end, with the FY provisional estimate on 31 May.
